gestures_and_limits: package query takes the exact package ID as its positional argument; exposed facets use repeated --where key=value operands; --json requests structured output.
dependency-depth requires both an exact depends predicate and an explicit dependency-target TFM. A starts-with predicate alone does not qualify.
depends with depth matches direct or transitive declaration paths through the selected maximum. depends-transitive is the legacy spelling and matches only depths 2 through the selected maximum.

Depth traversal admits at most five package candidates; this exact package ID admits one. For a prefix or ecosystem population, set the candidate work bound explicitly with --take N; -n N only limits final rows.
